name: Orihara Chiu
source:
Chika's younger sister. She's a huge brocon who tells everyone that she wants to get pregnant with his baby. She's jealous over her brother and wants to keep him exclusively for herself.

Her breasts grow when she takes an experimental drug. She later takes another drug that splits her into multiple copies of herself each with their own personality.
